name: polka
description: Полка (polochka.app): your agent saves HTML pages, reports and prototypes to your private shelf and gives you a link.

interface.shortDescription: Save AI pages, share by link
interface.longDescription: Полка keeps the pages, reports and prototypes you make with ChatGPT or Codex and gives you an unlisted link that recipients open without an account. The plugin connects https://polochka.app/mcp (you sign in in the browser, no token) and installs the Полка skills.
defaultPrompt: Save this page to Polka and give me a link
